step1_figure.circuit_type: Beta-Multiplier Voltage Reference (BMR) with Error Amplifier and Start-Up Circuit
step1_figure.description: A self-biased beta-multiplier voltage reference where an opamp (MA1-MA4) forces the drain voltages of M1 and M2 equal, with start-up circuit (MSU1-MSU3) and bypass capacitor MCP.

vref_nominal.description: Nominal reference output voltage at room temperature (25 C) and nominal VDD (1.8 V)

equation.formula: VREF = VGS1 = VTHN + sqrt(2 * IREF / beta_1)
equation.explanation: The operational amplifier enforces VREF = Vbiasn = VGS1. The reference voltage equals the gate-source voltage of M1.
equation.assumptions: M1 is in saturation, opamp has high open-loop gain to enforce virtual short between inputs.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard NMOS threshold in SKY130 is ~0.42 V with ~135 mV overdrive at 12 uA bias.

temperature_coefficient.description: Temperature coefficient of the reference voltage (TCV_REF) over 0 C to 100 C

equation.explanation: Calculates the fractional variation of VREF over temperature. As described in Example 23.3, VREF shifts ~40 mV over 100 C change (-400 uV/C or -800 ppm/C).
equation.assumptions: Resistor TCR = 2000 ppm/C, long-channel temperature dependence of mobility and threshold.

sky130_expected.calculation: Targeting dVREF/dT around -400 uV/C to -700 uV/C; for VREF = 0.56 V, TCV_REF = (-500 uV/C) / 0.56 V = -892 ppm/C. Total delta VREF over 100 C is approximately 40 mV to 60 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Consistent with textbook simulation result showing ~40 mV drop over 0 to 100 C.

line_regulation.description: Sensitivity of reference voltage to power supply voltage changes (dVREF / dVDD) in the operating region

equation.explanation: Measures how constant VREF remains once VDD exceeds the minimum saturation headroom.
equation.assumptions: Evaluated in the flat region between VDD = 1.2 V and 1.8 V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to the high open-loop gain of the differential error amplifier (MA1-MA4), drain voltages are forced equal, suppressing channel-length modulation. Delta VREF over 1.2 V to 1.8 V is typically < 10 mV, giving Line_Reg < 15 mV/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The self-biased amplifier provides high PSRR/line regulation compared to unassisted BMR.

vdd_min.description: Minimum supply voltage for reference output to stabilize

equation.explanation: Supply voltage at which the PMOS current mirror (M3, M4) enters the saturation region.
equation.assumptions: M3/M4 have |VTHP| ~ 0.42 V and overdrive ~ 0.15 V.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Below 1.1 V, the PMOS mirrors drop into triode and reference collapses toward 0 V.

iref_branch.description: Quiescent bias current per branch (M1 and M2 branches)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Long-channel quadratic model predicts ~12.2 uA with R=5.5k.

amplifier_offset.description: Error amplifier differential input voltage offset |VREF - Vbiasn|

equation.explanation: The amplifier forces drain voltages equal to guarantee equal branch currents.
equation.assumptions: Balanced differential pair MA1-MA2 and mirror MA3-MA4.

sky130_expected.calculation: Finite open-loop gain A_OL ~ 30 dB (31.6) results in an offset V_offset = delta_Vbiasp / A_OL < 5 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matched differential pair ensures low input-referred systematic offset.

startup_margin.description: Gate-to-source voltage of startup transistor MSU3 in normal operation

equation.explanation: In normal operating mode, MSU3 must be completely turned off to avoid corrupting reference current.
equation.assumptions: MSU1 pulls down node N002 below Vbiasn.

sky130_expected.calculation: MSU1 (10/2) is turned on by Vbiasn (~0.56 V). MSU2 is a long PMOS (10/20) diode load. V(N002) is pulled down near ground (< 0.1 V), giving VGS_MSU3 = V(N002) - Vbiasn ~ 0.05 - 0.56 = -0.51 V < 0.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Negative VGS guarantees MSU3 is strongly cut off during normal operation.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench for Baker Fig. 23.13 BMR voltage reference measuring nominal VREF, temperature performance, line regulation, minimum supply headroom, branch currents, and startup circuit state.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Baker Fig 23.13 Beta-Multiplier Voltage Reference Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter definitions from Fig. 23.13
.param W_xmsu1=10u  L_xmsu1=2u
.param W_xmsu2=10u  L_xmsu2=20u
.param W_xmsu3=10u  L_xmsu3=1u
.param W_xm3t=100u  L_xm3t=2u
.param W_xm4t=100u  L_xm4t=2u
.param W_xm2=40u    L_xm2=2u
.param W_xm1=10u    L_xm1=2u
.param W_xma1=10u   L_xma1=2u
.param W_xma2=10u   L_xma2=2u
.param W_xma3=100u  L_xma3=2u
.param W_xma4=100u  L_xma4=2u
.param W_xm3=100u   L_xm3=100u

* Supply Voltage
VDD VDD 0 1.8

* Circuit Netlist (DUT)
xmsu1 N002 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu1} l={L_xmsu1}
xmsu3 Vbiasp N002 Vbiasn 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
xmsu2 N002 N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu2} l={L_xmsu2}
xm3t Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3t} l={L_xm3t}
xm4t VREF Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4t} l={L_xm4t}
xm2 VREF VREF N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm1 Vbiasn Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
R1 N003 0 5500.0
xma4 Vbiasp N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xma4} l={L_xma4}
xma3 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xma3} l={L_xma3}
xma1 N001 VREF 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xma1} l={L_xma1}
xma2 Vbiasp Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xma2} l={L_xma2}
xm3 VDD Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}

.control
* 1. Operating Point at T = 25 C
set temp = 25
op
let vref_25 = v(VREF)
let vbiasn_25 = v(Vbiasn)
let v_off = abs(vref_25 - vbiasn_25)
let iref = v(N003) / 5500.0
let vgs_msu3 = v(N002) - v(Vbiasn)

print vref_25
print v_off
print iref
print vgs_msu3

* 2. Operating Point at T = 0 C and T = 100 C for Temperature Coefficient
set temp = 0
op
let vref_0 = v(VREF)

set temp = 100
op
let vref_100 = v(VREF)

let delta_vref_temp = vref_100 - vref_0
let tc_ppm = (delta_vref_temp / (100.0 * vref_25)) * 1e6
print vref_0 vref_100 delta_vref_temp tc_ppm

* 3. DC Supply Sweep from 0 to 1.8 V at T = 25 C
set temp = 25
dc VDD 0 1.8 0.01

meas dc vref_at_1p2 find v(VREF) at=1.2
meas dc vref_at_1p8 find v(VREF) at=1.8
let line_reg = (vref_at_1p8 - vref_at_1p2) / 0.6
print line_reg

meas dc vdd_min when v(VREF)=0.5 rise=1

quit
.endc
.end
